title: Per-token escrow credits for streaming sessions — enterprise contract crediting & compliance gating pilot
creator: Priya Raman
description: Background: Enterprise customers occasionally present long-lived streaming sessions with bursty egress patterns and handshake retries that create disproportionate billed-output spikes and manual crediting requests during contract negotiations and security questionnaire (SQ) reviews. This ticket pilots a per-session "escrow credits" mechanism that temporarily accrues ingress/egress token budget for a session and releases or refunds unused credits against enterprise reserved minimums when sessions end or fail. The goal is to reduce ad-hoc credit requests, smooth invoice volatility for committed customers, and surface a compliance-gated path that Legal/Security can sign off on for SQ responses.
hypothesis: If we provision per-stream escrow credits and tie release/refund rules to contract tier + completed security checklist, then billed token variance for enterprise streaming customers will drop and engineering/manual credit work will decline, with negligible negative revenue impact on committed customers.
experiment_design: A/B test over 8 weeks. Randomized by customer-account among enterprise customers eligible for reserved capacity. Control: current per-token billing. Treatment: implement escrow credits per streaming session based on customer tier and negotiated minimum (escrow = min(estimated_session_max_tokens, tier_buffer)). Two subgroups: (1) Conservative escrow (buffer=1.2x estimated) (2) Aggressive escrow (buffer=2.0x). Monitor billing, refunds, invoice complaints. Security gating: treatment only applied for customers who have passed a scoped checklist; otherwise opt-out.
rollout_plan: Week 0: Feature flagged internal dogfood on dedicated test orgs. Week 1-2: Small enterprise beta (5 accounts) with Sales + CS informed. Week 3-6: A/B rollout across eligible enterprise accounts (randomized). Week 7-8: Analyze metrics and decide to iterate, expand, or rollback. Full GA only after Legal and Security sign-off and after acceptance criteria met.
